video.description: Meet Mac, the orange tabby who treats attention like a full-time job. Every time work starts, he shows up with confidence, chaos, and perfect comedic timing.
video.thumbnail_alt: Orange tabby cat jumping toward a chair with bold text reading MY CAT HAS ONE JOB…

scenes.visual: Glowing-eye orange tabby locks onto the workspace.
scenes.caption: My cat has one job…

scenes.visual: Cat leaps toward a chair beside the desk.
scenes.caption: Reach for attention before I can work.

scenes.visual: Keyboard and laptop are blocked by paws.
scenes.caption: Every time I open my laptop, Mac clocks in.

scenes.visual: Confident cat close-up with boss-energy pose.
scenes.caption: No meetings. No deadlines. Just full-time chaos.

scenes.visual: Cat sits proudly like an employee of the month.
scenes.caption: Somehow, he still gets employee of the month.

scenes.visual: Freeze frame with bold thumbnail text.
scenes.caption: Would your pet get hired for this job?
